==== generated/broken-overlay.d/core/third.sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# GENERATED FILE, do not edit.
set -euxo pipefail

MODDIR=/ctx/modules/core/third
export MODDIR

if [ -f /etc/yum.repos.d/example.repo ]; then
    echo "repo example is already configured"
else
    source /ctx/modules/core/third/repo
fi

source /ctx/modules/core/third/module.sh
==== generated/broken-overlay.graph.md
# Broken Overlay capability graph

GENERATED FILE, do not edit.

An arrow points from a provider to what needs it, dotted for `after`,
which orders the build without requiring anything. Layers build left to
right.

```mermaid
graph LR
    base["quay.io/fedora/fedora-bootc:44"]
    m0["core/first"]
    m1["core/second"]
    m2["core/third"]
```

## Capabilities

| Name | Kind | Provided by | Required by | After |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rechunking` | capability | `base` |  |  |

## Overrides

| Module | Path |
|---|---|
| `core/third` | `/usr/lib/nothing.conf` |
